name: refrain
description: Refrain — a static-first PWA that streams a pre-rendered audio library of public-domain text, with a batch render pipeline and a private QC studio.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @refrain/catalogue && npm run build --workspace @refrain/pipeline && npm run build --workspace @refrain/listener
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/catalogue packages/pipeline && npm run typecheck --workspace @refrain/listener
scripts.pilot: npm run build --workspace @refrain/catalogue && npm run build --workspace @refrain/pipeline && node packages/pipeline/dist/cli.js pilot
